name: Three-qubit Clifford spider nest
summary: On three qubits, π/2 phases on every qubit, −π/2 gadgets on every pair and a π/2 gadget on all three give the identity.
description:
The three-qubit analogue of the [spider nest identity](../spider-nest/) with phases $\pm\frac\pi2$: a $\frac\pi2$ phase on each qubit, a $-\frac\pi2$ phase gadget on each pair of qubits and a $\frac\pi2$ gadget on all three qubits multiply to the identity (up to a scalar), because $\sum_{S}(-1)^{|S|+1}\bigoplus_{i\in S}x_i = 4x_1x_2x_3$ and $\frac\pi2\cdot 4 = 2\pi$.

As all the phases are Clifford, this identity can be proven with the Clifford rules, for instance by fusing and colour-changing until local complementation removes all the $\pm\frac\pi2$ spiders. The analogous identity with $\frac\pi4$ phases on three qubits is instead the CCZ gate.
